source_snapshot.items: NT.7_ConnectX-8 GPU Direct Test in IB XDR networking mode (1x 800G IB XDR)
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe; source requests log clearing; run NVQual Test #38; collect results/photos and inspect post-test logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All items should be passed without system hang or reboot.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 30 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; requires NVQual, ConnectX/BlueField and GPUDirect setup and notes saturation risk.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; held Pending for the exact 1x800G IB XDR path, direct registration, traffic matrix, integrity/performance/congestion limits, isolation and recovery.

old_problem: Generic GPUDirect output cannot prove the specified single-port 800G InfiniBand XDR negotiation, intended HCA/peer/switch path, direct GPU-memory registration, traffic directions, data integrity or acceptable congestion. Fabric identity, workload and limits were unbound.
disposition_reason: The row explicitly identifies 1x800G IB XDR GPUDirect through NVQual Test #38. Stable fabric identities, active-mode proof, traffic matrix and signed performance/integrity/congestion limits are Project Configuration. ED-05 keeps InfiniBand distinct from Ethernet, so a parameterized IB-specific gate resolves review without allowing an Ethernet or host-memory substitute.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2143, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2144 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00021-V002 / a127d542af964c52 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind the pinned Test #38 profile, GPU UUID/BDF, ConnectX-8 serial/HCA GUID/port/BDF, peer and switch-port identities plus PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU topology.
Prove active 1x800G InfiniBand XDR width/rate and direct GPU-memory registration before interpreting traffic; Ethernet, host-memory RDMA and PCIe-only bandwidth are not substitutes.
Pin direction, message-size, queue-pair/stream, concurrency, duration/repetitions and signed bandwidth/latency/integrity/retry/congestion/error limits; retain the 30-minute source coverage.
Isolate and drain the IB path, preserve/hash port/fabric/PCIe/GPU/host baselines, and collect complete raw payload, rate, latency, retry/congestion and synchronized health evidence.
Stop on wrong/lower mode, CPU staging, data mismatch, excessive retry/congestion, route/link fault, AER/NIC/GPU error, thermal/power limit, hang/reboot or evidence gap; no reset/retry.
No NVQual/IB/GDR traffic, fabric query, drain, log clearing, HCA/GPU/switch reset, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Single-port 800G InfiniBand XDR HGX NVQual Test #38 GPUDirect qualification
test_case.purpose: Drive GPUDirect RDMA through the exact ConnectX-8 1x800G IB XDR path and prove signed bandwidth, latency and payload integrity while fabric negotiation, congestion, endpoint and platform health remain acceptable without hang or reboot.
required_package: Licensed pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #38 with compatible GPU/ConnectX-8/CUDA/driver/firmware/DOCA-MOFED stack
Signed GPU UUID/BDF, HCA serial/GUID/port/BDF, peer/switch-port and PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU map
Approved active 1x800G IB XDR width/rate and direct-memory registration proof
Dedicated drained SUT, isolated non-production IB fabric, synchronized telemetry, abort and coordinated recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Preserve/hash port, fabric, PCIe, GPU and host baselines; isolate the exact IB path. Verify active 1x800G XDR and direct GPU-memory registration, then run only the pinned Test #38 matrix for 30 minutes. Retain raw per-direction/message/QP rate, latency, payload integrity, retry/congestion, link/fabric and platform evidence. Stop on first anomaly; do not force speed, reset or retry.
test_case.expected_result: The bound HCA port and peer remain active at approved 1x800G IB XDR, every configured direct-memory traffic profile meets signed bandwidth/latency/integrity/congestion limits, fabric and endpoints remain healthy, and no hang, reboot or disqualifying error occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until the exact IB topology, active XDR mode, direct-registration proof, workload and signed limits are bound. PASS requires every profile and synchronized fabric/device health artifact. FAIL on wrong/lower mode, wrong peer/path, CPU staging, integrity error, threshold miss, excessive retry/congestion, route/link/device fault, thermal/power breach, hang/reboot or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; Ethernet or aggregate-only output is insufficient.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until Test #38, exact IB fabric path, active XDR/direct-registration proof, workload, limits and recovery are signed.
Use a drained dedicated SUT and isolated non-production InfiniBand path; preserve all baselines.
Monitor port/fabric congestion, PCIe/NIC/GPU, thermal and power signals throughout the saturating run.
Stop without speed forcing, HCA/GPU/switch reset or automatic retry on first anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approved Test #38 profile and network authorization
GPU UUID/BDF, HCA serial/GUID/port/BDF, peer/switch-port and PCIe/NUMA/IOMMU map
Raw active 1x800G IB XDR state and GPUDirect memory-registration proof
Complete per-direction/message/QP/stream throughput, latency and payload-integrity results
Port/fabric retry/congestion/error counters plus PCIe/NIC/GPU/kernel/BMC/SEL/thermal/power evidence
First-fault coordinated recovery or verified clean final fabric/device state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On mode/path mismatch, data error, excessive retry/congestion, route/link/device fault, thermal/power limit or evidence gap, stop traffic and preserve first-fault artifacts. Do not force speed or reset HCA/GPU/switch automatically; follow coordinated fabric recovery and quarantine if the exact XDR path and endpoint health do not return.
